'ABOLISH NTF-ELCAC'

Progressive organizations trooped to the Department of Interior and Local Government (DILG) in Quezon City today, December 4, renewing calls to abolish the National Taskforce to End Local Communist Armed Conflict (NTF-ELCAC) on the 7th year of its existence.

Human rights groups led by KARAPATAN held a protest action earlier today condemning the continued existence of the NTF-ELCAC. According to Cristina Palabay, Secretary General of KARAPATAN, the NTF-ELCAC has been a source of government corruption since its inception during the past Rodrigo Duterte administration.

During the protest, Palabay described how the NTF-ELCAC used billions of taxpayers' money to fund its campaign of disinformation via red-tagging, programs such as the Barangay Development Program (BDP), forcing civilians to present themselves as 'rebel surrenderees' for money, and filing of bogus charges against progressives.

"Instead of allocating billions of pesos to this nefarious state terror machince, the Filipino people would be better served if such funds were rechanneled to urgently needed social services," said Palabay.

For 2026, the NTF-ELCAC proposed a P8.08 billion budget, 314% higher than in 2025, according to Karapatan.

Ronnie Manalo of the Kilusang Magbubukid ng Pilipinas (KMP) highlighted how the NTF-ELCAC targets legal democratic organizations via red-tagging, enforced disappearances, fake surrender, and EJKs, instead of genuinely solving the root of armed conflict in the country.

"Ang dahilan kung bakit mayroong armadong tunggalian sa bansa ay dahil walang lupa ang mga magsasaka, walang industriya, at sinusupil ang mga karapatan ng mamamayan," Manalo said during the protest.

Karapatan also denounced how the Marcos Jr administration is further strengthening the agency.

"As main implementer of the Marcos Jr administration's counterinsurgency blueprint, the National Action Plan for Unity, Peace, and Development (NAP-UPD), the NTF-ELCAC continues to be Marcos' machinery for state terrorism, despite domestic and international clamor for its abolition," Palabay added.

"This terrorizing agency is a bane to the Filipino people. It must be abolished immediately." (Adrian Puse/Altermidya)
